description:
Hushfacebook v0.1.7 targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 (com.facebook.katana), and 577.0.0.50.72 still works.

The Hushfacebook item stays first when you long-press Facebook's icon, so launchers that show only a few shortcuts keep it (#2). A new Clean up Reels patch takes the Follow button and the comment and reaction previews off reels, with a switch for each part. Download quality caps saved videos at 1080p, 720p, 480p or 360p, and Video file name builds names from a template. Download any reel is on by default. Short links such as fb.watch stay inside Facebook and saved files get the right extension. The settings screen reads better in all five languages.

There are 22 patches in all. Sponsored and suggested posts leave the news feed without a gap, and ads are gone from Stories and Reels. Facebook stops downloading ads in the background and sending ad telemetry. Links open in your browser and media can be saved. There's an AMOLED black theme and a Material You one.

Validation: 468 runtime tests passed locally. All 166 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lint checks. All 22 patches applied to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 with no manifest changes.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 from APKMirror. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
